what: Indio's 3-1 vote to extend the festival deal to 2050 was in August 2021, not October; October was the Empire Polo Club lease.
A $246 resale price for 2025 weekend-two passes was less than half of face value, not "about half".
The LEGO pyramid set was announced in 2026, with details due in 2027; it was not on sale in 2026.
The 2025 "KIKI BOY 2025" board isn't confirmed as Frank Ocean's; the text now says Rolling Stone asked whether he was teasing something, and its confidence is lowered to medium.
2026 was Sabrina Carpenter's first Coachella headline slot, not a return as headliner.
